peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is PCM change?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: A phase-change material (PCM) is a substance which releases/absorbs sufficient energy at phase transition to provide useful heat or cooling. Generally the transition will be from one of the first two fundamental states of matter - solid and liquid - to the other.
